name: Remix: Pragmatic Lexicon
description: Pragmatic Lexicon is a high-performance vocabulary and active-recall flashcard learning app tailored for software engineers, journalists, and professionals. Features 1,125 curated terms spanning engineering, global affairs, broadcast journalism, architecture, AI/LLM, and agile terminology with dual-language support (English and Tamil), British female English pronunciation, A–Z horizontal scroller, and interactive 3D study cards.
